details.description: Pasta tiburón Mac & Cheese Hacendado con salsa de queso
details.legal_name: Dehydrated pasta with seasoning cheese sauce
details.storage_instructions: Conservar en en lugar fresco y seco - COOKING INSTRUCTIONS: Pour 500 ml of unsalted water into a 20 cm diameter pot and bring to a boil. Pour the contents of the pouch into the boiling water, stir well and cook, over medium heat, uncovered, for about 9-11 minutes. Cooking time may vary depending upon the kind of heating source used.Stir occasionally until water is completely absorbed. Serve without draining. Garnish with butter and cheese, if desired.COOKING INSTRUCTIONS FOR MICROWAVE: In an appropriate container bring to a boil 450 ml of unsalted water. Pour the contents of the pouch into the boiling water. Stir well, cook uncovered on high for about 9-11 minutes, until water is completely absorbed. Garnish with butter and cheese, if desired.

nutrition_information.allergens: Contiene trigo y productos derivados. Puede contener moluscos y productos a base de moluscos. Contiene ml. Puede contener mostaza y productos derivados. Puede contener apio y productos derivados. Puede contener soja y productos a base de soja. Contiene leche y sus derivados (incluida la lactosa). Puede contener huevos y productos a base de huevo. Puede contener crustáceos y productos a base de crustáceos.
nutrition_information.ingredients: 68% pasta (durum wheat semolina), sauce 32% [processed cheese powder 32% (cheese, whey, salt), whey powder, sunflower oil preparation in powder (sunflower oil, glucose syrup, milk protein), flavours, potato starch, salt, yeast extract, onion, parsley, garlic]. May contain celery, soy, mustard, eggs, crustaceans and molluscs.
